outcome: Exclusive breastfeeding (EBF) status (at 1 week and 6 months)
cohort: The study included 548,318 neonates registered in the National Electronic Health System in northeastern Iran.
finding: While EBF prevalence was high in the first week (95.9%), it sharply declined to 52.3% by six months, with several socioeconomic and birth-related factors predicting non-EBF, and EBF infants demonstrating better growth metrics up to six months.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery was positively associated with sustained EBF, while cesarean section significantly predicted non-EBF.
cross-section timing: Data from neonates registered between 2018 and 2024, with EBF assessed at 1 week and 6 months of age.
